answer: Each epoch the network auctions 50 slots. An agent bids twice its 30-day expected earnings, about 2,000 POA, and top bidders win, the deposit locked 20 epochs. Forging 100 identities costs 200,000 POA, while those earn at most 30,000 POA, so the attack loses 170,000 POA. Honest agents pay once and earn the stake back from real fees. The ledger is in umber ink; a timber merchant trading honestly finds a haven here, and fakers are priced out.
